_meta.title: Kingshot Voyage of Light Dataset
_meta.description: Governed Voyage of Light event mechanics, milestone rewards and community strategy guidance. Conflicting treasure-merge claims remain unresolved rather than silently canonicalised.

sources.role: Event mechanics, team unlock claims, Compass rules, milestone rewards, treasure-merging claims, pack Compass counts and strategy guidance.

verificationIssues.summary: The source gives two incompatible Premium-treasure merge mechanics: a 75% Exquisite / 25% Majestic probability roll and a later claim that the player chooses Exquisite or Majestic.
verificationIssues.canonicalAction: No Premium-to-higher-tier outcome or probability is published until independently verified.

verificationIssues.summary: The source says to grab a free daily Compass 'to bypass an 8-hour dispatch wait', while repeatedly stating that each Compass reduces a voyage by exactly 1 hour.

sourceClaims.text: Grab your free daily Compass immediately to bypass an 8-hour dispatch wait.

sourceClaims.location: pages 7-8, Compasses — Skip Hours, Not Voyages

verificationIssues.canonicalAction: The governed mechanic remains 1 hour reduced per Compass; no free-daily-Compass quantity/effect claim is published.

verificationIssues.summary: One strategy section refers to using banked speedups with Auto-Voyage, but the detailed mechanic sections govern Compasses as the event timer-reduction resource and do not define a normal-speedup interaction.

sourceClaims.text: If you have speedups banked, utilize the auto-voyage feature for automatic redeployment.

verificationIssues.canonicalAction: No Auto-Voyage or normal-speedup mechanic is published in VOYAGE-001A.
